name.en: Power Patron Portal Plugging -Sword of Mutual Destruction-
name.ja: <ruby>獄<rt>ごく</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt>しん</rt></ruby><ruby>封<rt>ふう</rt></ruby><ruby>門<rt>もん</rt></ruby>－<ruby>共<rt>きょう</rt></ruby><ruby>滅<rt>めつ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>剣<rt>つるぎ</rt></ruby>－

text.en: Discard 1 "Power Patron" card; place 1 "Power Patron" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck in your Pendulum Zone, then if it is a Fusion Monster, you can place 1 "Power Patron" Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone. If you control a "Power Patron" monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1500 ATK, also it cannot attack this turn. You can only use each effect of "Power Patron Portal Plugging -Sword of Mutual Destruction-" once per turn.
